'''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version). This image was first published on 31 May 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/hires/scarifbeach.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
